pminus1_review.warning: Probability and runtime projections are heuristic; a no-factor outcome is not evidence of primality.

reservation_scope.route: independent Mersenne computation; not a PrimeNet assignment
reservation_scope.intent: Avoid duplicated computation while the reserving project performs factor-first screening, PRP, and deterministic Lucas-Lehmer proof if warranted.
reservation_scope.start_gate: Official status must be fetched again after publication and immediately before work; any assignment, factor, or result voids this reservation before work starts.
reservation_scope.result_policy: A factor, PRP result, Lucas-Lehmer residue, relinquishment, or expiry will be published in this repository.
reservation_scope.non_claim: This reservation is not a claim that the number is prime, a discovery announcement, a coordinator assignment, or an EFF award claim.
